transliteration: khuzil 'afwa waamur bil'urfi waa'rid 'anil jaahileen

translations.en.sahih: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
translations.en.pickthall: Keep to forgiveness (O Muhammad), and enjoin kindness, and turn away from the ignorant.
translations.en.yusufali: Hold to forgiveness; command what is right; But turn away from the ignorant.
translations.id.indonesian: Jadilah engkau pemaaf dan suruhlah orang mengerjakan yang ma'ruf, serta berpalinglah dari pada orang-orang yang bodoh.

arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌۭ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa immaa yanzaghannaka minash Shaitaani nazghun fasta'iz billaah; innahoo Samee'un Aleem

translations.en.sahih: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: And if a slander from the devil wound thee, then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is Hearer, Knower.
translations.en.yusufali: If a suggestion from Satan assail thy (mind), seek refuge with Allah; for He heareth and knoweth (all things).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jika kamu ditimpa sesuatu godaan syaitan maka berlindunglah kepada Allah

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَٰٓئِفٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ تَذَكَّرُوا۟ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Innal lazeenat taqaw izaa massahum taaa'ifum minash Shaitaani tazakkaroo fa izaa hum mubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who fear Allah - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil), when a glamour from the devil troubleth them, they do but remember (Allah's Guidance) and behold them seers!
translations.en.yusufali: Those who fear Allah, when a thought of evil from Satan assaults them, bring Allah to remembrance, when lo! they see (aright)!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa bila mereka ditimpa was-was dari syaitan, mereka ingat kepada Allah, maka ketika itu juga mereka melihat kesalahan-kesalahannya.

arabic: وَإِخْوَٰنُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغَىِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa ikhwaanuhum yamuddoonahum fil ghaiyi summa laa yuqsiroon

translations.en.sahih: But their brothers - the devils increase them in error; then they do not stop short.
translations.en.pickthall: Their brethren plunge them further into error and cease not.
translations.en.yusufali: But their brethren (the evil ones) plunge them deeper into error, and never relax (their efforts).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan teman-teman mereka (orang-orang kafir dan fasik) membantu syaitan-syaitan dalam menyesatkan dan mereka tidak henti-hentinya (menyesatkan).

arabic: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا ٱجْتَبَيْتَهَا ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ مِن رَّبِّى ۚ هَٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa lam taatihim bi aayatin qaaloo law lajtabai tahaa; qul innamaaa attabi'u maa yoohaaa ilaiya mir Rabbee; haazaa basaaa'iru mir Rabbikum wa hudanw wa rahmatul liqawminy yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: And when you, [O Muhammad], do not bring them a sign, they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur'an] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."
translations.en.pickthall: And when thou bringest not a verse for them they say: Why hast thou not chosen it? Say: I follow only that which is inspired in me from my Lord. This (Qur'an) is insight from your Lord, and a guidance and a mercy for a people that believe.
translations.en.yusufali: If thou bring them not a revelation, they say: "Why hast thou not got it together?" Say: "I but follow what is revealed to me from my Lord: this is (nothing but) lights from your Lord, and Guidance, and mercy, for any who have faith."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila kamu tidak membawa suatu ayat Al Quran kepada mereka, mereka berkata: "Mengapa tidak kamu buat sendiri ayat itu?" Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku hanya mengikut apa yang diwahyukan dari Tuhanku kepadaku. Al Quran ini adalah bukti-bukti yang nyata dari Tuhanmu, petunjuk dan rahmat bagi orang-orang yang beriman".

arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَأَنصِتُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa quri'al Quraanu fastami'oo lahoo wa ansitoo la 'allakum turhamoon

translations.en.sahih: So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.
translations.en.pickthall: And when the Qur'an is recited, give ear to it and pay heed, that ye may obtain mercy.
translations.en.yusufali: When the Qur'an is read, listen to it with attention, and hold your peace: that ye may receive Mercy.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila dibacakan Al Quran, maka dengarkanlah baik-baik, dan perhatikanlah dengan tenang agar kamu mendapat rahmat.

arabic: وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِى نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًۭا وَخِيفَةًۭ وَدُونَ ٱلْجَهْرِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْغَٰفِلِينَ
transliteration: Wazkur Rabbaka fee nafsika tadarru'anw wa kheefatanw wa doonal jahri minal qawli bilghuduwwi wal aasali wa laa takum minal ghaafileen

translations.en.sahih: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
translations.en.pickthall: And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.
translations.en.yusufali: And do thou (O reader!) Bring thy Lord to remembrance in thy (very) soul, with humility and in reverence, without loudness in words, in the mornings and evenings; and be not thou of those who are unheedful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sebutlah (nama) Tuhanmu dalam hatimu dengan merendahkan diri dan rasa takut, dan dengan tidak mengeraskan suara, di waktu pagi dan petang, dan janganlah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang lalai.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيُسَبِّحُونَهُۥ وَلَهُۥ يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
transliteration: Innal lazeena 'inda Rabbika laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihee wa yusabbihoonahoo wa lahoo yasjudoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who are near your Lord are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who are with thy Lord are not too proud to do Him service, but they praise Him and prostrate before Him.
translations.en.yusufali: Those who are near to thy Lord, disdain not to do Him worship: They celebrate His praises, and prostrate before Him.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya malaikat-malaikat yang ada di sisi Tuhanmu tidaklah merasa enggan menyembah Allah dan mereka mentasbihkan-Nya dan hanya kepada-Nya-lah mereka bersujud.
